# TV remote (`tv-remote`)

A direction pad with OK, back and home, volume and channel rockers, and input or app buttons.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTvRemote` (types in `dist/web/home/media-voice/tvRemote.d.ts`): `.mh-tv-remote`: a labelled group. A `__top` row (`__key--power`, `--mute` with `aria-pressed`, `--play-pause`); the `__pad`, a labelled group with four `__dir` buttons around the `__ok` button (with focus on the pad, the arrow keys send directions); a `__nav` row (back, home, menu); `__rocker`s for volume and channel (each a group with `__step--up`, the short `__rocker-label` and `__step--down`); and a `__sources` group of buttons, the active one `aria-pressed`. Direction, volume and channel keys repeat while held.

```ts
export function createTvRemote(options: TvRemoteOptions): TvRemoteHandle;

export interface TvRemoteOptions extends TvRemoteData, TvRemoteEvents {}

export interface TvRemoteHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: TvRemoteOptions): void;
  /** Stops a key that is repeating. */
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface TvRemoteData {
  /** The keys to show (default all of them); the sources row appears when there are `sources`. */
  keys?: readonly TvRemoteKey[];
  sources?: readonly TvRemoteSource[];
  /** The mute key reads as pressed. */
  muted?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name (default "Remote"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<TvRemoteLabels>;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface TvRemoteEvents {
  /** A key press; held direction, volume and channel keys repeat. */
  onKey?: (key: TvRemoteKey) => void;
  onSource?: (id: string) => void;
}

/** Every word the remote shows or speaks. */
export interface TvRemoteLabels {
  remote: string;
  navigation: string;
  up: string;
  down: string;
  left: string;
  right: string;
  ok: string;
  back: string;
  home: string;
  menu: string;
  power: string;
  mute: string;
  'play-pause': string;
  volume: string;
  'volume-up': string;
  'volume-down': string;
  channel: string;
  'channel-up': string;
  'channel-down': string;
  /** Short words on the rockers. */
  volumeShort: string;
  channelShort: string;
  sources: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiGamepadVariant, mdiHdmiPort, mdiTelevisionPlay } from '@mdi/js';
import { createTvRemote, type TvRemoteOptions, type TvRemoteSource } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let sources: TvRemoteSource[] = [
  { id: 'hdmi1', label: 'HDMI 1', icon: mdiHdmiPort },
  { id: 'console', label: 'Console', icon: mdiGamepadVariant },
  { id: 'films', label: 'Film Hall', icon: mdiTelevisionPlay, active: true },
];
let muted = false;

const send = (command: string): void => void fetch('/tv/command', { method: 'POST', body: command });

const options = (): TvRemoteOptions => ({
  label: 'Living room TV',
  sources,
  muted,
  onKey: (key) => {
    send(key);
    if (key === 'mute') {
      muted = !muted;
      remote.update(options());
    }
  },
  onSource: (id) => {
    send(`source:${id}`);
    sources = sources.map((s) => ({ ...s, active: s.id === id }));
    remote.update(options());
  },
});

const remote = createTvRemote(options());

document.body.append(remote.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiGamepadVariant, mdiHdmiPort, mdiTelevisionPlay } from '@mdi/js';
import { TvRemote } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TvRemoteKey } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const sources = [
  { id: 'hdmi1', label: 'HDMI 1', icon: mdiHdmiPort },
  { id: 'console', label: 'Console', icon: mdiGamepadVariant },
  { id: 'films', label: 'Film Hall', icon: mdiTelevisionPlay },
];

const send = (command: string): void => void fetch('/tv/command', { method: 'POST', body: command });

export function TvRemoteExample() {
  const [source, setSource] = useState('films');
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false);
  const pressKey = (key: TvRemoteKey) => {
    send(key);
    if (key === 'mute') setMuted((m) => !m);
  };
  const pickSource = (id: string) => {
    send(`source:${id}`);
    setSource(id);
  };
  return (
    <TvRemote
      label="Living room TV"
      sources={sources.map((s) => ({ ...s, active: s.id === source }))}
      muted={muted}
      onKey={pressKey}
      onSource={pickSource}
    />
  );
}
```
